forbidden.name: ui-no-app-dependency
forbidden.comment: Shared UI package should not depend on the app layer

forbidden.name: app-no-direct-server-dependency
forbidden.comment: App should communicate with the server through the SDK

forbidden.name: core-no-application-dependency
forbidden.comment: Core domain logic should not import from server, app, desktop or the agent runtime (see docs/adr/0008-sesion-runtime-vs-engagement.md)

forbidden.name: infra-no-application-dependency
forbidden.comment: Infrastructure adapters should not depend on server or app

forbidden.name: plugin-no-desktop
forbidden.comment: Plugins should be framework-agnostic and not depend on Electron

forbidden.name: context-no-component-imports
forbidden.comment: Context providers should not import UI components to avoid circular chains. Las 3 excepciones son deuda conocida (modulos de logica viviendo en components/); moverlos a hooks/ o utils/ y retirarlas del allow.

forbidden.name: no-dist-imports
forbidden.comment: Source files must not import from dist, out, or build directories

forbidden.name: desktop-main-isolation
forbidden.comment: Desktop main process should not import renderer code
